name: Sundown Marsh
summary: In the Wetlands' far west, Sundown Marsh holds deep water, stagnant pools, and dangerous wildlife. An eccentric pair keeps a solitary home along its muddy borders.

sections.title: A Wild and Murky Sinkhole
sections.body: Sundown Marsh fills the Wetlands' deepest, westernmost reaches, where deep water and thick mud hide a dense population of predators. Giant crocolisks, shifting oozes, roaming raptors, and territorial Mosshide gnolls move through the mist. Most travelers keep to the main cobblestone road between Menethil Harbor and Ironforge, leaving this corner largely untamed.

sections.title: Life at the Edge of the Mire
sections.body: A lonely stone cottage with a churning windmill stands amid the marsh's hazards. The gnome Fradd Swiftgear and the dwarf Wenna Silkbeard make their living scavenging the bog. They sell curiosities and rare trade recipes recovered from the mire to travelers who brave its aggressive denizens.

faq.answer: Sundown Marsh lies in the Wetlands' deepest, westernmost reaches, in the northwest and away from the main royal roads.

The gnome Fradd Swiftgear and the dwarf Wenna Silkbeard live in a small stone dwelling with a windmill. They make their living scavenging the bog and sell oddities and rare goods to passing travelers.

faq.q: What threats can be found in Sundown Marsh?
faq.answer: Giant crocolisks, foul oozes, bog beasts, raptors, and hostile Mosshide gnolls threaten travelers. These dangers discourage casual exploration.

faq.q: Why would an adventurer travel into Sundown Marsh?
aliases: reasons to go to sundown marsh
faq.answer: Travelers visit the windmill cottage to trade with Fradd Swiftgear and Wenna Silkbeard, who offer rare recipes and peculiar curiosities scavenged from the surrounding swamp.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can see Fradd Swiftgear and Wenna Silkbeard make a home with their windmill outpost in dangerous mud. Their ingenuity shows how gnomes can make a comfortable home anywhere.
